content.short: Nad.fun is a Monad memecoin launchpad with fair-launch bonding curves that graduate to a DEX.
content.description: Nad.fun is a launchpad and trading terminal on Monad where tokens are created, traded and used in prediction markets. Its terminal ranks tokens by latest trade, market cap, 24-hour volume and creation date, so new launches surface as they move. A creator leaderboard tracks the accounts behind the most active tokens. A bridge is built into the same interface for moving assets onto the chain.
content.meta: Fair-launch bonding curves on Monad that move liquidity to a DEX once a threshold is hit.
